title: Concrete regular coefficient unit
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and positive quotients $A_{n+1}=R/\varpi^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use strict semilinear coefficient systems and their ordinary derived category and exact evaluations [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. Define the ordinary coefficient unit to be the sequence coefficient ring regarded as its regular sheaf of modules. Define its derived unit to be that module placed in degree zero by the existing derived single functor. These are actual constructions, with no chosen witness.
